### Summary of Changes

1. **[DcBlocker.h](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/DSP/DcBlocker.h) and [DcBlocker.cpp](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/DSP/DcBlocker.cpp)**
   - Implements a 1st-order high-pass difference equation: $y_{dc}(n) = x(n) - x(n-1) + R \cdot y_{dc}(n-1)$ with $R = 0.9975$.
   - Maintains per-channel $x(n-1)$ and $y_{dc}(n-1)$ states dynamically inside a pre-allocated vector to avoid real-time heap allocations.
   - Restores/flushes state on `reset()`.

2. **[ToneFilter.h](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/DSP/ToneFilter.h) and [ToneFilter.cpp](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/DSP/ToneFilter.cpp)**
   - Implements a 2nd-order low-pass filter utilizing the RBJ Audio EQ Cookbook equations.
   - Tone cutoff is adjustable in the $1\text{ kHz} - 16\text{ kHz}$ range with a default of $6.5\text{ kHz}$.
   - Cutoff frequency is smoothed using a multiplicative `juce::SmoothedValue`.
   - Biquad coefficients are updated once per sample inside the processing loop if smoothing is active, and applied to all channels.
   - Employs a Direct Form II transposed structure for filtering.
   - Cleans up state variables when they decay near zero to avoid denormals.

### Real-Time/DSP Constraints Met
- **No heap allocations, locking, file I/O, or string operations** are performed in the per-sample or block processing path. All channel states are sized/allocated in `prepare` (up to a safe maximum of 8 channels).
- **`juce::ScopedNoDenormals`** is instantiated at the top of the block processing method for both classes.
- Only the specified files in `allowed_write_paths` were created or modified. Both source files compiled successfully with the project's flags and configuration.
